title: Hardest hitters alive
subtitle: Ranked by our Attack rating, from real research on all 273 animals on the site.
caption: The 5 animals alive today with the highest Attack rating on Animal Battle Stats. Number 1 isn't a land animal. Who did we miss?

facts.orca: In Antarctica, orcas work as a team to make waves that wash seals off floating ice.
facts.african-elephant: The largest land animal alive. A big bull can weigh more than 5 tonnes.
facts.saltwater-crocodile: The largest living reptile. One tracked male swam over 400 km in 20 days to get back home.
facts.sperm-whale: Its clicks are the loudest sound ever measured from any animal.
facts.hippopotamus: When a hippo trots fast, all four of its feet can leave the ground at once.
